summary.text: Fiona McFarland represents District 73 in the Florida House of Representatives as a Republican, elected in 2020 and reelected subsequently.

paragraphs.text: McFarland lives in Sarasota and is a former business management consultant. McFarland served in the U.S. Navy from 2008 to 2016 and in the Navy Reserve from 2016 to 2023.
McFarland holds a B.S. in political science from the U.S. Naval Academy (2008) and an MBA from the University of North Carolina's Kenan-Flagler Business School (2013).
